answer: Locks are written down in shale, expire in grove, and knoll lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 15 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Anyone running 122 aliases hence needs 78 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 2649 identities would post 4885 proofs and burn roughly 82 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
